audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks Mandarin in an upbeat, high-pitched, and engaging tone. Simultaneously, high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong four-on-the-floor beat starts. (2) A sharp, high-pitched child's voice yells 'Go!', marking a shift in focus. The music continues consistently in the background. (3) The child's voice becomes very loud and high arousal, shouting 'No eyes!' in English. The adult female laughs and responds with high-pitched Mandarin. (4) Multiple iterations of the child shouting words like 'Nose!' and 'Apple!' occur. These are percussive vocal events interspersed with adult laughter. (5) A new child's voice, identifying as male through timbre, speaks English clearly saying 'My turn'. The upbeat BGM significantly lowers in volume. (6) A distinct 'ding' SFX (train arrival chime) rings out, signaling a change in environment. An adult male voice is heard briefly in the background. (7) The sound of footsteps on a hard surface is heard alongside the child's playful laughter as the music fades out completely.
